name: This is Money
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-client && sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || true; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sudo -u postgres pg_isready -q && break; sleep 1; done; sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "select 1 from pg_roles where rolname='timleaderboard'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres createuser timleaderboard; sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "select 1 from pg_roles where rolname='ubuntu'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres createuser ubuntu; sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "select 1 from pg_database where datname='thisismoney'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres createdb --owner=timleaderboard thisismoney; sudo -u postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d thisismoney -f /workspace/server/schema.sql; sudo -u postgres psql -d thisismoney -c "grant select, insert, update on leaderboard_scores to ubuntu;"; cd /workspace/server && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
start: sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start || true; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sudo -u postgres pg_isready -q && break; sleep 1; done
